column1: # THE COMPLETE L AND Ll SWEEP — Rosario cathedral baptism index, "Indice de bautismos 1879-1900".
# Read 10 September 2026. This finishes a job that had been done in pieces across several sessions and
# closes it: every opening of the L section and of the Ll section, from the first to the last, in order,
# with the year and folio span of each verified on arrival.
# *** METHOD - and why it is now reliable rather than approximate. ***
# The index is TYPEWRITTEN, not handwritten. FamilySearch serves each page as DeepZoom tiles at
# Level 13 is the maximum for this film: 20 x 15 tiles of 257 px, about 5100 x 3800 px for a two-page
# opening. Assembling the tiles into a plain HTML grid at 42% scale puts a whole opening on one screen at
# a size where every surname is legible. The viewer's own zoom could not do this; the tiles could.
# Recorded so the next person does not repeat the fight with the viewer.
# *** ON THE ARKS. *** Image NUMBERS drift between viewer states and are not trustworthy. The image ARK
# is stable and is what this file records. Arks are given without the "3:1:9Q97-Y3S2-" prefix they all share.
# THE RESULT, IN ONE LINE: no LERENA, no LLERENA, no LARENA, no LORENA, in any year, in either section.
